# Draft:Battle of the Blue and Gold

----
Battle of Blue and Gold is an annual cricket encounter between Nugawela Central College and Walala A. Ratnayake Central College, held at the Asgiriya Stadium in Kandy. This event is a significant fixture in the schools' sports calendars.
History
The inaugural match took place in 2004. As of 2024, Nugawela Central College leads the series with six victories, while Walala A. Ratnayake Central College has secured four wins. Notably, Nugawela Central achieved a 115-run victory in the 2024 encounter.
